verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a hosted search database with a dashboard, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack does not document any built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Features such as native embedding, managed reranking and dashboard query browsing are related features, not an assistant that takes on tasks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
